ti: Δ. Νατσιός: Σε πνευματική καθίζηση ο λαός μας – Υπερφίαλος, αλαζόνας και εκτός πραγματικότητας ο Μητσοτάκης
s: NIKI president Dimitris Natsios gave a radio interview criticizing the government's economic and energy policies, accusing Prime Minister Mitsotakis of being arrogant and out of touch with reality, and calling for a stronger stance on Greek-Turkish relations.

q.o: Δεν είναι ούτε πολιτικό το σύστημα, είναι παραπολιτικό, είναι μικροπολιτικό, είναι ένα γκανγκστερικό, θα έλεγα, σχέδιο… Έχουν καταστρέψει και πνευματικά την πατρίδα μας, εκτός από την οικονομική και κοινωνική καθίζηση. Αυτό είναι το χειρότερο
q.t: The system is not even political, it is para-political, it is micro-political, it is a gangster-like scheme, I would say... They have also destroyed our homeland spiritually, in addition to the economic and social collapse. This is the worst thing

q.o: Μην ψαλιδίζουμε την ελπίδα, να μην τη χάσουμε γιατί θα χαθεί και το γέλιο στο πρόσωπο των παιδιών, και αν χαθεί θα καταντήσουμε ένα απέραντο νεκροταφείο
q.t: Let's not cut off hope, let's not lose it because the laughter on children's faces will also be lost, and if it is lost we will become a vast cemetery

q.o: Όταν η Τουρκία απειλεί, εμείς τι λέμε; "Θα το πω στη μαμά μου"… Η διαχρονική απάντηση της Ελλάδος στις επιβουλές των Τούρκων έπρεπε να είναι δύο λέξεις, για να αναθαρρήσει ο λαός: "Μολών λαβέ"
q.t: When Turkey threatens, what do we say? 'I'll tell my mom'... Greece's timeless response to Turkish machinations should be two words, to encourage the people: 'Molon labe' [Come and take them]

q.o: Είναι εκτός τόπου και χρόνου
q.t: He is out of place and time

ti: Η ανάπτυξη μειώνει στροφές και κατεβάζει ταχύτητα – Η Ελλάδα υστερεί σε εξαγωγές και απασχόληση
s: NIKI's Economic Team criticized the Greek government's seven-year economic policy, stating that despite unprecedented European fund inflows, Greece's economy shows limited dynamism with GDP growth of 1.9% in Q2 2026, employment declining by 0.4%, and exports growing at half the EU rate.

q.o: Στη ΝΙΚΗ πιστεύουμε οτι μετά από 7 χρόνια αντιλαϊκής κυβερνητικής οικονομικής πολιτικής, η ελληνική οικονομία παραμένει εγκλωβισμένη στις ίδιες δομικές αδυναμίες.
q.t: At NIKI we believe that after 7 years of anti-popular governmental economic policy, the Greek economy remains trapped in the same structural weaknesses.

q.o: Οι αριθμοί της Eurostat καταγράφουν το αποτύπωμα και τις επιπτώσεις, αυτή η 7ετία μετριέται: σε παραγωγή που δεν έγινε, σε εξαγωγές που υστέρησαν, σε ευρωπαϊκούς πόρους που δεν μεταφράστηκαν στην αναγκαία οικονομική δυναμική σε ευκαιρίες που χάθηκαν.
q.t: Eurostat's numbers record the imprint and consequences, this seven-year period is measured: in production that did not happen, in exports that lagged, in European resources that were not translated into the necessary economic dynamism, in opportunities that were lost.

ti: Δ. Νατσιός στο Pontos TV: Οι εξαγγελίες Μητσοτάκη είναι κοροϊδία – Η ΝΙΚΗ μπήκε στην πολιτική με σημαία την αξιοπρέπεια
s: NIKI president Dimitris Natsios categorically ruled out any pre-election or post-election cooperation with New Democracy or other parties, criticized the government's policy announcements as inadequate, and reaffirmed the party's positions on traditional family values and opposition to same-sex marriage legislation.

q.o: Καταστατική αρχή της ΝΙΚΗΣ είναι να μην συνεργάζεται με ανθρώπους οι οποίοι υπέγραψαν τα εγκληματικά, για εμάς και για πολύ κόσμο, μνημόνια
q.t: It is a statutory principle of NIKI not to cooperate with people who signed the memoranda, which are criminal for us and for many people

q.o: Πώς μπορείς να συνεργαστείς σε μια κυβέρνηση, γιατί έχουμε και ταυτοτικές διαφορές, που ψήφισε τον ψευτο γάμο των ομοφυλοφίλων
q.t: How can you cooperate in a government, because we also have identity differences, that voted for the fake marriage of homosexuals

q.o: Εμείς μπήκαμε στην πολιτική με σημαία μας την αξιοπρέπεια
q.t: We entered politics with dignity as our flag

q.o: Εμείς φτιάχνουμε οικογένειες κανονικές, με παπά και με κουμπάρο, με άντρα και γυναίκα
q.t: We create normal families, with a priest and a best man, with a man and a woman

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 announced support for a demonstration and march on Monday 21 September at 18:30 at Gladstownos and gatherings across Greece marking eight years since the killing of Zak Kostopoulos, calling for justice and continued struggle against transphobia, homophobia, racism, patriarchy, and fascism.

q.o: 8 χρόνια μετά την άγρια δολοφονία του Ζακ στο κέντρο της Αθήνας ο αγώνας για δικαιοσύνη και ορατότητα συνεχίζεται.
q.t: 8 years after the brutal murder of Zak in the center of Athens the struggle for justice and visibility continues.

q.o: Χρέος μας είναι να συνεχίσουμε τον αγώνα ενάντια σε κάθε μορφή πατριαρχίας, σεξισμού, ομοφοβίας, τρανσφοβίας, ρατσισμού και φασισμού.
q.t: It is our duty to continue the struggle against every form of patriarchy, sexism, homophobia, transphobia, racism and fascism.

q.o: Ως ΛΟΑΤΚΙ+ άτομα και ως άτομα που στεκόμαστε στο πλευρό της ΛΟΑΤΚΙ+ κοινότητας, στηρίζουμε μαζί με άλλες συλλογικότητες τη συγκέντρωση και πορεία την Δευτέρα 21 Σεπτεμβρίου στις 18:30 στη Γλάδστωνος και τις συγκεντρώσεις σε όλη την Ελλάδα.
q.t: As LGBTQI+ people and as people who stand by the side of the LGBTQI+ community, we support together with other collectives the gathering and march on Monday 21 September at 18:30 at Gladstownos and the gatherings across Greece.

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 Secretary Yanis Varoufakis issued a statement commemorating Margarita Papandreou, praising her legacy for advancing Greek women's freedom and independence.

q.o: Το πέρασμα της από αυτό τον κόσμο άφησε τις Ελληνίδες πιο ελεύθερες, πιο ανεξάρτητες, πιο ικανές να ορίζουν τις τύχες τους. Στη Μαργαρίτα Παπανδρέου αξίζουν τιμές που κάποια στιγμή θα αποδοθούν. Θα μου λειψει η σκέψη της φυσικής της παρουσίας. Και θα την κρατώ στη σκέψη μου.
q.t: Her passing from this world left Greek women more free, more independent, more capable of determining their own fates. Margarita Papandreou deserves honors that will be bestowed at some point. I will miss the thought of her physical presence. And I will keep her in my thoughts.

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app

q.o: Ως ΜέΡΑ25 Ενωτική Αριστερά δηλώσαμε ότι στηρίζουμε με όλες μας τις δυνάμεις τη διεκδίκηση-στόχο της Επιτροπής να αποδοθεί η μεγάλη έκταση του Υπουργείου Αγροτικής Ανάπτυξης (εξαιρουμένων των κτιριακών εγκαταστάσεων) στον Δήμο Αγίας Παρασκευής, ως πράσινος ελεύθερος χώρος αναψυχής
q.t: As MeRA25 United Left we declared that we support with all our forces the Committee's demand-goal that the large area of the Ministry of Agricultural Development (excluding building facilities) be transferred to the Municipality of Agia Paraskevi as a green open recreational space

q.o: Ως ΜέΡΑ25 Ενωτική Αριστερά θεωρούμε τα ζητήματα κλιματικής κρίσης, βιώσιμης πόλης, πρασίνου και προστασίας του περιβάλλοντος κορυφαία στο πρόγραμμά μας και από τις πιο σημαντικές μάχες της εποχής μας!
q.t: As MeRA25 United Left we consider the issues of climate crisis, sustainable city, green spaces and environmental protection as top priorities in our program and among the most important battles of our era!

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 calls for mass participation in a memorial march on 18 September 2026 marking 13 years since the murder of Pavlos Fyssas by Golden Dawn, framing the event as urgent antifascist vigilance coinciding with the release of convicted neo-Nazi Ilias Kasidiaris.

q.o: Ως ΜέΡΑ25 Ενωτική Αριστερά απευθύνουμε κάλεσμα μαζικής συμμετοχής στην πορεία μνήμης για τα 13 χρόνια από τη δολοφονία του Παύλου Φύσσα, στο Κερατσίνι από το τάγμα εφόδου της ΧΑ.
q.t: As MeRA25 United Left we issue a call for mass participation in the memorial march for 13 years since the murder of Pavlos Fyssas in Keratsini by the assault battalion of Golden Dawn.

q.o: Δεν θα επιτρέψουμε το σκοτάδι του νεοναζισμού και ο φόβος να επιστρέψει στους δρόμους και τις γειτονιές μας, ούτε θα δεχτούμε το ξέπλυμα των εγκλημάτων τους από ένα σύστημα που τους χρησιμοποιεί ως χρήσιμα εργαλεία.
q.t: We will not allow the darkness of neo-Nazism and fear to return to our streets and neighborhoods, nor will we accept the whitewashing of their crimes by a system that uses them as useful tools.

q.t: 5.67 million over-indebted people are above all a damning indictment of this federal government.

q.o: Digitale Bezahlangebote nach dem Prinzip 'heute kaufen, später zahlen' müssen so streng geregelt werden, dass junge Menschen nicht länger mit einem Klick in die Schuldenfalle gelockt werden.

ti: 3e RPIMa de Carcassonne : les discours politiques et d’extrême droite n’ont pas leur place dans nos armées
s: La France insoumise parliamentary group demands immediate dismissal of a military chaplain and investigation after Le Canard enchaîné revealed he made political statements against "leftists" and referenced "great replacement" theory during a Saint-Michel celebration at the 3rd Marine Infantry Parachute Regiment in Carcassonne, with the group also announcing they will file a judicial report under Article 40.

q.o: Les images révélées par Le Canard enchaîné sont extrêmement graves. Lors d'une célébration de la Saint-Michel devant des militaires du 3e régiment de parachutistes d'infanterie de marine, l'aumônier du régiment s'est livré à une diatribe ouvertement politique, s'en prenant aux « gauchistes » et développant un discours faisant écho à la pseudo théorie du « grand remplacement ».
q.t: The images revealed by Le Canard enchaîné are extremely serious. During a Saint-Michel celebration before soldiers of the 3rd Marine Infantry Parachute Regiment, the regiment's chaplain engaged in an openly political diatribe, attacking 'leftists' and developing a discourse echoing the pseudo-theory of 'great replacement'.

q.o: Le groupe la France insoumise exige la radiation immédiate de l'aumônier et une enquête immédiate de l'inspection pour établir les faits dans leur entièreté et comprendre notamment comment de tels faits ont pu se produire sans réaction du commandement.
q.t: The La France insoumise group demands the immediate dismissal of the chaplain and an immediate inspection investigation to establish the facts in their entirety and understand in particular how such facts could occur without reaction from the command.

q.o: L'armée française appartient à la Nation tout entière. Aucun courant politique, aucune idéologie et aucun militantisme partisan ne peuvent se l'approprier.
q.t: The French army belongs to the entire Nation. No political current, no ideology and no partisan activism can appropriate it.

ti: Non à la fermeture programmée du service des urgences de l’hôpital militaire de Metz
s: La France insoumise deputies on the national defense commission demand cancellation of the planned closure of the emergency service at Legouest military hospital in Metz, scheduled for early 2027, and call for coordination between public health actors to maintain emergency care access.

q.o: Les députés de La France insoumise exigent l'annulation de cette décision et le renoncement à cette fermeture programmée.
q.t: The deputies of La France insoumise demand the cancellation of this decision and the abandonment of this planned closure.

q.o: Ils demandent à la ministre des Armées de garantir les moyens nécessaires afin que le Service de santé des armées (SSA), qui opère dans cet hôpital, maintienne l'accès aux soins d'urgence pour les populations civiles et militaires de Metz et de sa région.
q.t: They ask the Minister of the Armed Forces to guarantee the necessary means so that the Armed Forces Health Service (SSA), which operates in this hospital, maintains access to emergency care for the civilian and military populations of Metz and its region.

ti: Fuites sur la garde à vue de Rima Hassan : les révélations de « Complément d’enquête » mettent en cause Laurent Nuñez
s: La France insoumise demands the resignation of Laurent Nuñez, former Interior Minister, after revelations that he exchanged information with journalists about Rima Hassan's police custody, including details covered by investigation secrecy.

q.t: Did the Interior Minister himself transmit or confirm to journalists information covered by investigation secrecy?

q.o: Face à ces révélations, Laurent Nuñez doit tirer les conséquences de la gravité des faits mis en lumière. La France insoumise demande sa démission.
q.t: In light of these revelations, Laurent Nuñez must draw the consequences of the gravity of the facts brought to light. La France insoumise demands his resignation.

q.o: Cette nouvelle affaire met une fois de plus en lumière la gravité des pratiques employées par des membres du gouvernement à l'encontre d'une opposante politique.
q.t: This new affair once again highlights the gravity of practices employed by government members against a political opponent.

q.t: The Austrian Students' Union invites a former Al-Qaeda member to an event – FPÖ announces parliamentary inquiries to the Interior and Science Ministers.

q.t: Important domestic future technology excluded from EU funding – nuclear power and Chinese imports are preferred

ti: Harvard-Studie zeigt Erwärmung durch Windparks
s: FPÖ MEP Gerald Hauser announced a parliamentary question demanding the EU Commission investigate and disclose the effects of wind farm expansion on local temperatures and soil moisture, citing Harvard and Chinese studies showing warming effects.

q.o: Windkraftanlagen verursachen messbare lokale Klima-Effekte, und trotzdem wird dieses Problem von EU-Kommission, Einheitspartei und Mainstream-Medien konsequent ausgeblendet. Gerade angesichts des heißen Sommers und zunehmender Trockenperioden ist es höchste Zeit, die Auswirkungen des massiven Windkraft-Ausbaus auf Temperaturen, Böden und Dürren ehrlich zu untersuchen
q.t: Wind turbines cause measurable local climate effects, and yet this problem is consistently ignored by the EU Commission, the unity party and mainstream media. Especially in light of the hot summer and increasing drought periods, it is high time to honestly investigate the effects of massive wind power expansion on temperatures, soils and droughts

q.o: Die EU-Kommission muss endlich mit offenen Karten spielen. Wenn sie den weiteren massiven Ausbau der Windkraft vorantreibt, muss sie auch offenlegen, welche Auswirkungen dieser Ausbau auf unser lokales Klima, unsere Böden, die Landwirtschaft und zukünftige Dürreperioden haben kann
q.t: The EU Commission must finally play with open cards. If it is pushing ahead with the further massive expansion of wind power, it must also disclose what effects this expansion can have on our local climate, our soils, agriculture and future drought periods

ti: Treibstoffpreise: Italienische Regierung zeigt, wie es geht
s: FPÖ MEP Roman Haider praised the Italian government's suspension of vehicle taxes and fuel tax reductions, demanding Austria adopt similar measures including abolishing the Normverbrauchsabgabe (registration tax), reducing motor insurance tax, and lowering fuel taxation.

q.o: Die italienische Regierung unter Premierministerin Giorgia Meloni und Verkehrsminister Matteo Salvini zeigt, wie es geht
q.t: The Italian government under Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and Transport Minister Matteo Salvini shows how it's done

q.o: Das zeigt, dass eine Entlastung der Bürger in Zeiten angespannter Budgets möglich ist. Das gilt ebenso für Österreich
q.t: This shows that relief for citizens is possible in times of tight budgets. This also applies to Austria

q.o: Um die Bürger zu entlasten, halte ich sowohl eine Senkung der motorbezogenen Versicherungssteuer und der Treibstoff-Besteuerung nach italienischem Vorbild wie auch die Abschaffung der Normverbrauchsabgabe für machbar und sinnvoll
q.t: To relieve citizens, I consider both a reduction in motor-related insurance tax and fuel taxation following the Italian model, as well as the abolition of the registration tax, to be feasible and sensible

s: FPÖ media spokesperson and general secretary Christian Hafenecker criticized the ORF for allegedly downplaying child abuse allegations against cabaret artist Günther Paal and demanded that ORF director-general Thurnher take immediate action and distance the broadcaster from Paal.

q.o: Vom ORF ist man schon einiges gewohnt. Wie jetzt aber versucht wird, den Kindesmissbrauchs-Skandal rund um den seit Jahrzehnten zum ORF-Inventar gehörenden Günther Paal herunterzuspielen und zu verharmlosen, ist ein ORF-Skandal ganz neuer, widerlicher Dimension und muss Konsequenzen haben. ORF-Generaldirektorin Thurnher ist jetzt dringend gefordert, hier sofort aufzuräumen!
q.t: We are used to quite a lot from the ORF. But how they are now trying to downplay and trivialize the child abuse scandal surrounding Günther Paal, who has been part of the ORF inventory for decades, is an ORF scandal of a completely new, disgusting dimension and must have consequences. ORF director-general Thurnher is now urgently required to clean this up immediately!

q.o: Finanzieren mussten diesen zutiefst abstoßenden Beitrag wieder die Österreicher mit der ORF-Zwangssteuer, die ersatzlos abgeschafft gehört.
q.t: Austrians had to finance this deeply repulsive contribution again with the ORF compulsory tax, which should be abolished without replacement.

q.t: After Florian Teichtmeister, Paal is the second ORF star to make headlines for possession of child abuse depictions.

q.o: Österreich braucht keinen ÖVP-Bürgertäuscher und Totalversager im Innenministerium, sondern eine Politik, die den Schutz der eigenen Bevölkerung an die erste Stelle setzt. Das bedeutet einen sofortigen und lückenlosen Asyl-Stopp mit der ‚Festung Österreich'.
q.t: Austria does not need an ÖVP deceiver of citizens and total failure in the Interior Ministry, but rather a policy that puts the protection of its own population first. This means an immediate and complete asylum stop with 'Fortress Austria'.

q.o: The Data Centres operating in Ireland can easily pay for normal Irish energy prices, but THEY get it HALF PRICE. Their prices should go up, and ours should come down through our plan for a 500 euro energy credit.

ti: Budget Office: 95% of Households Are Better Off Under People Before Profit’s Proposals Than Any Others
s: People Before Profit released Budget 2026 proposals that the Parliamentary Budget Office analyzed as benefiting 95% of households with average income gains of 9.4%, funded by €46.4 billion in net revenue raising primarily through corporation and capital taxes.

q.o: The report from the Parliamentary Budget Office demonstrates just how progressive People Before Profit's 2026 budget proposals are. Under our proposals, 95% of households would be better off, while the wealthiest 5% and corporations would pay significantly higher taxes to begin the redistribution of income and wealth that is so urgently required.

By taxing multi-millionaires and big corporations, we demonstrated that we can increase average incomes for middle income households by 14.2%. According to the PBO this compares to 1.4% increase from the Social Democrats' proposals for middle income earners, 3.2% by Labour and 4.5% by Sinn Féin.

People Before Profit is serious about transforming our society through a just transition to an equal and sustainable ecosocialist society. Our budget proposals provide an insight on how we can finance such a transition

There is vast wealth in this State and a left government must have an ambitious plan for redistribution from the wealthiest 5% to the 95%, the people who create the wealth, if it is to fulfill the aspirations of our voters.

ti: La mauvaise mémoire n’est pas le problème
s: solidaritéS publishes an analysis arguing that the AfD's electoral success in Germany (43.8% in Saxe-Anhalt, 38.2% in Mecklembourg-Poméranie-Occidentale on 6 September 2026) cannot be explained by voters forgetting Nazi history, but rather by the contemporary far-right's dissociation of fascist ends from genocidal means, and calls for antifascist politics to address material causes of crisis rather than relying solely on historical memory.

q.o: Le 6 septembre 2026, le parti d'extrême droite Alternative für Deutschland a obtenu 43,8% des suffrages aux élections régionales en Saxe-Anhalt et 38,2% deux semaines plus tard dans le Mecklembourg-Poméranie-Occidentale.
q.t: On 6 September 2026, the far-right party Alternative für Deutschland obtained 43.8% of votes in regional elections in Saxe-Anhalt and 38.2% two weeks later in Mecklembourg-Poméranie-Occidentale.

q.o: Rappeler les crimes de l'extrême droite à travers l'histoire est insuffisant pour lutter contre ses formes contemporaines.
q.t: Recalling the crimes of the far-right throughout history is insufficient to fight against its contemporary forms.

q.o: Une politique antifasciste à visée émancipatrice ne peut donc se réduire à la seule défense de l'ordre démocratique: dans le même temps, elle doit aussi rouvrir le conflit sur la répartition des richesses, l'austérité, l'efficacité des services publics et la dégradation des conditions de vie.
q.t: An antifascist politics with emancipatory aims cannot therefore be reduced to the sole defense of democratic order: at the same time, it must also reopen the conflict over the distribution of wealth, austerity, the effectiveness of public services and the degradation of living conditions.

s: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Stefan Möller responds to party ban discussions, stating that two new Federal Constitutional Court cases regarding weapons permits revoked due to AfD membership could provide clarity on legal standards comparable to those for party bans.

q.o: Angesichts der aufgeheizten politischen Stimmungslage und den potentiellen gesellschaftlichen Folgen eines Verbots der im Osten Deutschlands mit Abstand stärksten Partei wäre es wünschenswert, wenn das Bundesverfassungsgericht die mit den Verfahren verbundene Gelegenheit nutzt, seine aus der NPD-Ära stammende Rechtsprechung zu konkretisieren.
q.t: Given the heated political atmosphere and the potential social consequences of banning the by far strongest party in eastern Germany, it would be desirable if the Federal Constitutional Court uses the opportunity connected with these proceedings to concretize its jurisprudence stemming from the NPD era.

ti: Tino Chrupalla: Energiesteuer senken - Alternative für Deutschland
s: AfD federal spokesman Tino Chrupalla calls for the German government to reduce energy taxes on petrol and diesel to the European minimum and abolish the national CO2 price in response to rising fuel prices driven by Houthi militia conquests.

q.o: Die Bundesregierung muss nun dringend die Energiesteuer auf Benzin und Diesel auf das europäische Mindestmaß senken und den nationalen CO2-Preis abschaffen. Deutsche Pendler und Betriebe zahlen derzeit einen Aufschlag, den ihre europäischen Wettbewerber nicht zahlen. Dieser Sonderweg gehört in diesem Herbst beendet.
q.t: The federal government must now urgently reduce the energy tax on petrol and diesel to the European minimum and abolish the national CO2 price. German commuters and businesses currently pay a surcharge that their European competitors do not pay. This special path must be ended this autumn.

ti: L’ouverture du procès d’Aramburu nous rappelle que l’extrême droite tue
s: La France insoumise issued a statement on the opening of the trial for the 2022 murder of Argentine rugby player Federico Martin Aramburu by far-right activists Loïk Le Priol and Romain Bouvier, stating that the far-right is responsible for 90% of ideological murders and pledging to oppose it in parliament, elections, and the streets.

q.o: Les deux militants d'extrême droite ont, selon la vidéosurveillance et les multiples témoins, pourchassé Federico Martin Aramburu et Shaun Hegarty, l'un de ses amis rugbyman, après une bagarre entre les 4 hommes dans un bar parisien.
q.t: The two far-right activists, according to video surveillance and multiple witnesses, chased Federico Martin Aramburu and Shaun Hegarty, one of his rugby player friends, after a fight between the 4 men in a Parisian bar.

q.o: Cet assassinat commis par des néonazis nous met face à la violence meurtrière de l'extrême droite, qui est responsable de 90% des meurtres idéologiques.
q.t: This assassination committed by neo-Nazis confronts us with the murderous violence of the far-right, which is responsible for 90% of ideological murders.

q.o: À l'Assemblée nationale, dans les urnes et dans la rue, nous continuerons à nous y opposer par tous les moyens à notre disposition.
q.t: In the National Assembly, at the ballot box and in the streets, we will continue to oppose it by all means at our disposal.

ti: Communiqué de presse - Ukraine : critiquer la guerre ne peut pas valoir quinze ans de prison
s: La France insoumise condemns the fifteen-year prison sentence given to Ukrainian socialist activist Bogdan Syrotiuk for writing articles critical of the Ukrainian government and NATO, calling for the annulment of his conviction while reaffirming condemnation of the Russian invasion.

q.o: Le 10 août 2026, un tribunal ukrainien a condamné Bogdan Syrotiuk, militant socialiste de 27 ans, à quinze années de prison pour « haute trahison », assorties de la confiscation de ses biens.
q.t: On August 10, 2026, a Ukrainian court sentenced Bogdan Syrotiuk, a 27-year-old socialist activist, to fifteen years in prison for 'high treason', along with the confiscation of his property.

q.o: La France insoumise condamne sans réserve l'invasion russe, défend la souveraineté et l'intégrité territoriale de l'Ukraine ainsi que le droit du peuple ukrainien à la paix.
q.t: La France insoumise unreservedly condemns the Russian invasion, defends the sovereignty and territorial integrity of Ukraine as well as the right of the Ukrainian people to peace.

q.o: La solidarité avec un peuple agressé n'impose jamais l'alignement sur son gouvernement.
q.t: Solidarity with an attacked people never requires alignment with its government.

ti: Pourquoi nous ne répondrons à aucune invitation de BFMTV cette semaine
s: La France insoumise announces a boycott of BFMTV this week, citing last-minute cancellations, editorial drift toward far-right themes, and false reporting about Rima Hassan's detention.

q.o: Ainsi, nous avons observé avec stupéfaction la place prépondérante donnée à des plateaux durant lesquels des thèses racistes ou encore des propos climatosceptiques sont monnaie courante.
q.t: Thus, we have observed with astonishment the predominant place given to programs during which racist theses or climate-skeptic remarks are commonplace.

q.o: Pendant plusieurs heures ont été relayées sur cette antenne, sans aucune prudence, des accusations graves sur la possible détention de drogue de sa part lors d'une garde à vue. Ces informations se sont avérées fausses mais rien n'a été fait par la chaîne pour corriger cette désinformation manifeste.
q.t: For several hours, serious accusations about her possible possession of drugs during police custody were broadcast on this channel without any caution. This information proved false but nothing was done by the channel to correct this obvious disinformation.

s: Marine Le Pen and Jean-Luc Mélenchon are projected to advance to a French presidential run-off election, with centrist candidates being sidelined.

ti: 25 Jahre 9/11: Wahres Gedenken bedeutet, unsere Bürger vor Terror zu schützen
s: FPÖ leader Herbert Kickl, marking the 25th anniversary of 9/11, warns against imported Islamism in Europe and calls for building a "Fortress Austria" with border protection and an absolute asylum stop.

q.o: Der 11. September 2001 hat die Welt für immer verändert. Es war die Geburtsstunde des islamistischen Terrors in der westlichen Welt, der tausende unschuldige Menschenleben gefordert hat.
q.t: September 11, 2001 changed the world forever. It was the birth of Islamist terror in the Western world, which has claimed thousands of innocent lives.

q.o: Wir mussten schmerzhaft miterleben, wie der Terror auch unseren Kontinent erfasst hat. Diese tragische Entwicklung wurde durch den unkontrollierten Grenzsturm des Jahres 2015 massiv befeuert.
q.t: We had to painfully witness how terror also gripped our continent. This tragic development was massively fueled by the uncontrolled border storm of 2015.

q.o: Es braucht den Bau der ‚Festung Österreich' mit echtem Grenzschutz und einem absoluten Asyl-Stopp. Nur so können wir garantieren, dass unser Land sicher bleibt und unsere Freiheit verteidigt wird!
q.t: We need to build 'Fortress Austria' with real border protection and an absolute asylum stop. Only in this way can we guarantee that our country remains safe and our freedom is defended!

ti: Bablers ORF-"Zukunftsforum" war eine Farce, Ergebnisse sind mieser Reformschwindel
s: FPÖ media spokesperson Christian Hafenecker criticizes SPÖ leader Andreas Babler's ORF reform forum as a sham that cements government control over the public broadcaster, demanding abolition of the mandatory ORF fee and announcing a planned referendum on ORF reform.

q.o: Wenn kritische Stiftungsräte kurzerhand ausgeschlossen und Vertreter privater Medien zu Statisten degradiert werden, dann hat das nichts mit einem ehrlichen Dialog zu tun. Das war keine Reformdebatte, das war eine Krönungsmesse für den eigenen Propaganda-Apparat, dessen Ergebnisse schon längst in Bablers Schublade vorbereitet lagen
q.t: When critical foundation council members are summarily excluded and representatives of private media are degraded to extras, then that has nothing to do with honest dialogue. That was not a reform debate, that was a coronation mass for their own propaganda apparatus, whose results had long been prepared in Babler's drawer

q.o: An erster Stelle steht die ersatzlose Abschaffung der ORF-Zwangssteuer! Es kann nicht sein, dass die Österreicher für eine Finanzierung von etwas zwangsverpflichtet werden, das sie in weiten Teilen weder sehen wollen noch als objektiv empfinden.
q.t: First and foremost is the complete abolition of the ORF mandatory tax! It cannot be that Austrians are compulsorily obligated to finance something that they largely neither want to watch nor perceive as objective.

ti: Schluss mit dem Herumlavieren, Herr Kanzler!
s: FPÖ General Secretary Michael Schnedlitz criticizes the ÖVP government for failing to implement a ban on political Islam and calls on them to support the FPÖ's legislative proposal, accusing the ÖVP of enabling mass immigration and Islamization over forty years in government.

q.o: Statt leerer Ankündigungen, Rückzieher und wochenlangem Herumlavieren brauchen Kanzler Stocker und seine Integrationsministerin nur für eines zu sorgen: Die ÖVP soll dem längst beschlussfertig im Parlament vorliegenden FPÖ-Antrag für ein Verbotsgesetz gegen den politischen Islam zustimmen
q.t: Instead of empty announcements, backtracking and weeks of wavering, Chancellor Stocker and his Integration Minister only need to ensure one thing: The ÖVP should approve the FPÖ motion for a ban law against political Islam that has long been ready for decision in Parliament

q.o: Wer den islamistischen Terrorismus bekämpfen will, der muss diesem zuerst das ideologische Fundament entziehen
q.t: Whoever wants to fight Islamist terrorism must first remove its ideological foundation

q.o: Der politische Islam ist die größte Bedrohung für die Sicherheit in Österreich
q.t: Political Islam is the greatest threat to security in Austria

q.o: Das ist ein fatales Signal. Ein Gesetz ist keine Empfehlung, sondern gilt ab dem ersten Tag. Wenn das Kopftuchverbot gleich am ersten Schultag ignoriert wird, müssen die politisch Verantwortlichen im Bund und in Wien jetzt handeln
q.t: That is a fatal signal. A law is not a recommendation, but applies from the first day. If the headscarf ban is ignored on the very first day of school, those politically responsible at the federal level and in Vienna must now act

ti: News

q.t: SPÖ plans create massive incentives for migration into our social system, instead of tightening the screws on those who refuse to work.

s: NIKI criticizes the government for prison overcrowding (14,055 inmates in facilities designed for 10,763) and links this to failed migration policy, demanding improved correctional infrastructure, border protection, and zero tolerance for violence in prisons.

q.t: Greece cannot be an open vineyard and its prisons warehouses of governmental failure.

s: NIKI party, represented by MP Tasos Oikonomopoulos, participated in the "Katsoneια 2026" memorial ceremony in Skiathos on 14 September 2026, laying a wreath to honor the 32 crew members of the submarine "Katsonis" who died in combat on 14 September 1943 during World War II.

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ τιμά τους ήρωες του Πολεμικού Ναυτικού και κρατά ζωντανή την ιστορική μνήμη, ως χρέος απέναντι στους νεκρούς και ευθύνη απέναντι στις επόμενες γενιές.
q.t: NIKI honors the heroes of the Navy and keeps historical memory alive, as a duty to the dead and a responsibility to future generations.

ti: Νατσιός: «Σώζεις» το σπίτι σου μόνο αν το θελήσουν οι πιστωτές; Η παγίδα πίσω από τη νέα ρύθμιση του εξωδικαστικού
s: NIKI president Dimitris Natsios submitted a parliamentary question to the Minister of National Economy and Finance Kyriakos Pierrakakis challenging the new out-of-court debt settlement mechanism, arguing that debtors cannot independently request to dispose of other property to save their primary residence but must wait for creditors to propose this option.

q.o: Η νέα διάταξη προβλέπει ότι οι συμμετέχοντες πιστωτές μπορούν να υποβάλουν αντιπρόταση, η οποία περιλαμβάνει την εκποίηση των υπόλοιπων ακινήτων του οφειλέτη, με εξαίρεση την κύρια κατοικία.
q.t: The new provision stipulates that participating creditors can submit a counterproposal, which includes the disposal of the debtor's remaining properties, with the exception of the primary residence.

q.o: Ο Δημήτρης Νατσιός ζητά να διευκρινιστεί γιατί ένας πολίτης που επιθυμεί να διαθέσει άλλο ακίνητο προκειμένου να διατηρήσει το σπίτι στο οποίο κατοικεί δεν μπορεί ο ίδιος να ζητήσει την ενεργοποίηση αυτής της διαδικασίας με σαφείς και αντικειμενικούς όρους.
q.t: Dimitris Natsios asks for clarification as to why a citizen who wishes to dispose of another property in order to keep the house in which they live cannot themselves request the activation of this procedure with clear and objective terms.

ti: ΜέΡΑ25 app
s: MeRA25 issued a statement condemning private media channels for broadcasting the release of convicted neo-Nazi Ilias Kasidiaris and called for a demonstration on 18 September 2026 at the Pavlos Fyssas memorial in Kokkinias.

q.o: Το αίμα δεν είναι νερό, η μνήμη δεν είναι σκουπίδι και ο φασισμός δεν είναι gossip.
q.t: Blood is not water, memory is not garbage, and fascism is not gossip.

q.o: Ως ΜέΡΑ25 Ενωτική Αριστερά καλούμε κάθε εργαζόμενο, εργαζόμενη, νέο και νέα την Παρασκευή 18 Σεπτεμβρίου στις 17:30, στο μνημείο του Παύλου Φύσσα, για να διαδηλώσουμε μέσα από τις γειτονιές του μπλόκου της Κοκκινιάς και της Αντιφασιστικής Αντίστασης ενάντια σε κάθε απόπειρά νεκρανάστασης των ναζιστών εγκληματιών.
q.t: As MeRA25 United Left we call on every worker, male and female, young man and woman on Friday 18 September at 17:30, at the Pavlos Fyssas memorial, to demonstrate through the neighborhoods of the Kokkinias block and the Antifascist Resistance against any attempt at resurrection of the Nazi criminals.

q.o: Η προσπάθεια κανονικοποίησης του φασισμού δεν θα περάσει Ο ναζισμός θα τσακιστεί ξανά!
q.t: The attempt to normalize fascism will not pass. Nazism will be crushed again!

ti: Alice Weidel: Zehn-Punkte-Plan der Merz-Regierung ist der Offenbarungseid einer gescheiterten Migrationspolitik - Alternative für Deutschland
s: AfD federal spokesperson Alice Weidel criticized the Merz government's ten-point plan against Islamist terror as an admission of failed migration policy, demanding instead border protection, deportation of Islamist threats, and an indefinite migration stop from culturally foreign countries.

q.o: Der jetzt vorgelegte ‚Zehn-Punkte-Plan' ist nichts anderes als das Eingeständnis, dass die Migrationspolitik der Bundesregierung restlos gescheitert ist.
q.t: The now-presented 'ten-point plan' is nothing other than the admission that the federal government's migration policy has completely failed.

q.o: Deutschland braucht keine halbherzigen Absichtserklärungen, sondern eine sofortige, echte Migrationswende! Dazu gehören der lückenlose und dauerhafte Schutz unserer Landesgrenzen, die sofortige und rigorose Abschiebung aller islamistischen Gefährder sowie ein strikter, unbefristeter Aufnahmestopp für Migranten aus kulturfremden Herkunftsländern.
q.t: Germany does not need half-hearted declarations of intent, but an immediate, genuine migration turnaround! This includes comprehensive and permanent protection of our national borders, the immediate and rigorous deportation of all Islamist threats, as well as a strict, indefinite admission stop for migrants from culturally foreign countries of origin.

ti: Sven Tritschler: Kanzler Merz fordert das Ende der Meinungsfreiheit - Alternative für Deutschland
s: AfD deputy federal spokesman Sven Tritschler criticized Chancellor Merz for stating "Please, nobody come to me with Free Speech" at a Youth Research competition, accusing him of demanding the end of freedom of expression and a free society.

q.o: Bitte komme mir keiner mit Free Spech
q.t: Please, nobody come to me with Free Speech

q.o: Mit seiner Äußerung ‚Bitte komme mir keiner mit Free Spech' und seiner Forderung, der Staat müsse Bürger ‚vor falschen Informationen, vor persönlichen Herabsetzungen, vor Diskriminierung' schützen, fordert der Kanzler nichts weniger als das Ende einer freiheitlichen Gesellschaft wie wir sie kennen.
q.t: With his statement 'Please, nobody come to me with Free Speech' and his demand that the state must protect citizens 'from false information, from personal degradation, from discrimination,' the Chancellor is demanding nothing less than the end of a free society as we know it.

q.o: Wer prüft denn, ob eine Information richtig oder falsch ist? Ein Wahrheitsministerium? Nein, Merz fordert das Ende der Meinungsfreiheit.
q.t: Who checks whether information is right or wrong? A Ministry of Truth? No, Merz is demanding the end of freedom of expression.

ti: Die umbenannte SED siegt wieder, diesmal bei den Kindern
s: Die Heimat Berlin chairman Andreas Käfer criticized the Linke party's first-place finish (32.8%) in Berlin's U16 mock election, calling it a consequence of inadequate education about SED dictatorship history and demanding stronger instruction about DDR totalitarianism.

q.o: Wenn eine Partei, die aus der SED hervorgegangen ist, bei Vierzehn- und Fünfzehnjährigen fast ein Drittel der Stimmen holt, dann hat das nichts mit den Kindern zu tun. Das hat mit dem zu tun, was ihnen im Unterricht erzählt wird, und mit dem, was ihnen dort nicht erzählt wird.
q.t: When a party that emerged from the SED gets almost a third of the votes among fourteen- and fifteen-year-olds, that has nothing to do with the children. It has to do with what they are told in class, and with what they are not told there.

q.o: Wer die Geschichte der SED-Diktatur verschweigt, braucht sich über ihre Wiederkehr nicht zu wundern.
q.t: Whoever conceals the history of the SED dictatorship should not be surprised about its return.

q.o: Die Linke enteignet gern das, was sie selbst verkauft hat. Erst der Ausverkauf, dann die große Empörung darüber. Das ist keine Wohnungspolitik, das ist Amnesie mit Programm.
q.t: Die Linke likes to expropriate what it sold itself. First the sell-off, then the great outrage about it. That's not housing policy, that's amnesia by design.

ti: 15,55 % für Manfred Börm und die HEIMAT
s: Die Heimat's local electoral group in Handorf achieved 15.55% and two council seats in the 2026 municipal election, with state chairman Manfred Börm receiving the most individual votes of all candidates.

q.o: Die Obrigkeit hat kein Rückgrat
q.t: The authorities have no backbone

q.o: Wir leiden unter den Vorgaben der Bundespolitik.
q.t: We suffer under the directives of federal politics.

q.o: Trotz meiner bekannten Vergangenheit haben die Leute mich gewählt, weil sie mich kannten und als Handwerksmeister auch akzeptierten.
q.t: Despite my known past, people voted for me because they knew me and also accepted me as a master craftsman.

ti: Presseerklärungen
s: Die Linke issued multiple press statements in September 2026 criticizing the federal budget's military spending priorities, opposing Chancellor Merz's plan to abolish early retirement at 63, calling for better care financing redistribution, and demanding that "never again war" become the supreme principle of international politics on Anti-War Day.

ti: Pflegefinanzierung auf bessere Füße stellen!
s: Die Linke party chair Ines Schwerdtner calls for transforming Germany's care insurance into full coverage funded by all income types in response to municipal demands to redistribute care costs.

q.o: Die steigenden Pflegekosten sind nicht vom Himmel gefallen. Seit vielen Jahren ist Pflegebedürftigkeit ein Armutsrisiko.
q.t: The rising care costs did not fall from the sky. For many years, needing care has been a poverty risk.

q.o: Die Pflegeversicherung muss zu einer Pflege-Vollversicherung ausgebaut werden und die Finanzierung auf breitere Füße gestellt werden. Wenn alle mit allen Einkommensarten einzahlen, muss niemand mehr Angst vor Pflegekosten haben.
q.t: Care insurance must be expanded into full care coverage and financing must be placed on broader footing. If everyone pays in with all income types, no one needs to fear care costs anymore.

ti: Wahlbericht Landtagswahl Sachsen-Anhalt
s: Die Linke published an election report summarizing and commenting on the results of the Saxony-Anhalt state election, with party leaders issuing statements on care financing, federal budget, and pension policy in the election's aftermath.

ti: À propos de la présence de la France insoumise sur BFMTV
s: La France insoumise announced it will resume appearances on BFMTV after the channel made commitments on transparency, cancellations, and fact-checking, but will boycott specific programs it considers far-right oriented, including those hosted by Sonia Mabrouk and featuring Raphaël Enthoven or Robert Ménard.

q.o: À la suite de la décision de la France insoumise de ne pas se rendre sur les plateaux de BFMTV la semaine dernière, des échanges ont eu lieu entre la France insoumise et la direction de la chaine.
q.t: Following La France insoumise's decision not to appear on BFMTV's programs last week, exchanges took place between La France insoumise and the channel's management.

q.o: C'est la raison pour laquelle la France insoumise ne participera ni à l'émission animée par la journaliste Sonia Mabrouk, ni à celle mettant en scène des dialogues avec le propagandiste anti-LFI Raphaël Enthoven ou le maire d'extrême droite de Béziers Robert Ménard.
q.t: This is why La France insoumise will participate neither in the program hosted by journalist Sonia Mabrouk, nor in those featuring dialogues with anti-LFI propagandist Raphaël Enthoven or the far-right mayor of Béziers Robert Ménard.

ti: Déchets nucléaires éternels : aveu de mensonge et passage en force
s: La France insoumise condemned the favorable opinion on the Cigéo nuclear waste burial project in Meuse, calling it an undemocratic rush by the Macron government ahead of 2027 elections.

q.o: Le groupe de la France Insoumise condamne le nouveau passage en force sur Cigéo. La peur des élections de 2027 par les macronistes et la filière nucléaire ne saurait servir de prétexte à cette accélération brutale et antidémocratique du calendrier d'un chantier prévu pour durer près de deux siècles.
q.t: The France Insoumise group condemns the new forcing through of Cigéo. The fear of the 2027 elections by the Macronists and the nuclear sector cannot serve as a pretext for this brutal and undemocratic acceleration of the schedule for a project planned to last nearly two centuries.

ti: An LFI MP publishes with Fayard: “This is not our choice,” declares Mathilde Panot - entrevue.fr
s: Mathilde Panot publicly distanced La France insoumise from an LFI MP's decision to publish with Fayard publishing house.

q.o: Ce n'est pas notre choix
q.t: This is not our choice

ti: News
s: The FPÖ published multiple statements criticizing COVID-19 pandemic management, vaccine policies, and alleged cover-ups by Austrian and EU authorities, demanding investigations into excess mortality, pharmaceutical contracts, and vaccine safety particularly for pregnant women and children.

q.o: Der Selbstbedienungsladen für Systemgünstlinge muss restlos aufgeklärt werden
q.t: The self-service shop for system favorites must be completely clarified

q.o: Bewusste Täuschung des Parlaments: Das Ministerium leugnet Kontakte zur Pharmabranche und blockiert die Aufarbeitung
q.t: Deliberate deception of Parliament: The ministry denies contacts with the pharmaceutical industry and blocks the investigation

q.o: Fauci wusste von Fehlgeburts-Risiken durch die Corona-Impfung! Während US-Medien berichten, vertuscht der ORF den Skandal
q.t: Fauci knew about miscarriage risks from the Corona vaccination! While US media report, the ORF covers up the scandal

ti: COFAG-Sumpf: 158 Millionen sind nur die Spitze des Eisbergs
s: FPÖ deputy club chair Dagmar Belakowitsch criticized a Finance Ministry report showing 158.8 million euros in wrongly received Corona aid, calling it proof of systematic tax-money waste and announcing the party will pursue full investigation through a Corona inquiry committee.

q.o: Jahrelang haben wir Freiheitliche vor dem Selbstbedienungsladen COFAG gewarnt, einem undurchsichtigen Monster, geschaffen von der schwarz-grünen Regierung, um unter dem Deckmantel der Pandemiebekämpfung Milliarden an Steuergeld ohne parlamentarische Kontrolle zu verschleudern.
q.t: For years we Freedom Party members have warned about the COFAG self-service shop, an opaque monster created by the black-green government to squander billions in tax money without parliamentary control under the guise of pandemic control.

q.o: Unter einer FPÖ-geführten Bundesregierung mit einem Volkskanzler Herbert Kickl werden die Selbstbedienungsläden für Systemgünstlinge ein für alle Mal zugesperrt. Wir werden diesen Sumpf trockenlegen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Euro dem Wohl der österreichischen Bevölkerung dient und nicht in den Taschen von dubiosen Netzwerken verschwindet!
q.t: Under an FPÖ-led federal government with a people's chancellor Herbert Kickl, the self-service shops for system favorites will be closed once and for all. We will drain this swamp and ensure that every euro serves the welfare of the Austrian population and does not disappear into the pockets of dubious networks!

ti: Brüsseler Kriegstreiberei stoppen – Von der Leyen führt Europa in den Abgrund
s: FPÖ leader Herbert Kickl criticized EU Commission President von der Leyen's State of the Union address for lacking diplomatic peace efforts and focusing on military escalation, calling for Austria to strengthen its neutrality and act as a peace mediator instead of following Brussels' policies.

q.o: Frau von der Leyen führt die Europäische Union sehenden Auges weiter auf den Pfaden der Kriegstreiberei. Wer in dieser Rede auch nur ein einziges Wort der Deeskalation oder ernsthafter Friedensbemühungen gesucht hat, wurde bitter enttäuscht.
q.t: Mrs. von der Leyen is leading the European Union with open eyes further down the path of warmongering. Anyone who looked for even a single word of de-escalation or serious peace efforts in this speech was bitterly disappointed.

q.o: Für uns bedeutet diese Entwicklung im Umkehrschluss, dass wir uns umso stärker auf die immerwährende Neutralität besinnen und die eigene Souveränität vehement einfordern müssen. Wenn die Rufe nach militärischer Aufrüstung in Brüssel lauter werden, muss die Republik als aktiver Friedensvermittler auftreten!
q.t: For us, this development means conversely that we must focus all the more strongly on perpetual neutrality and vehemently demand our own sovereignty. When calls for military armament in Brussels become louder, the Republic must act as an active peace mediator!

q.o: Die österreichische Bundesregierung wandelt als braver Lakai Brüssels auf genau diesen gefährlichen Pfaden mit und gefährdet damit mutwillig die Sicherheit und den Wohlstand unserer eigenen Bevölkerung.
q.t: The Austrian federal government walks as a obedient lackey of Brussels on exactly these dangerous paths and thereby willfully endangers the security and prosperity of our own population.

q.o: Diejenigen, die sich gegen diese Brüsseler Kriegslust stellen, sind keine Feinde Europas. Ganz im Gegenteil: Wir sind die wahren Verfechter des ursprünglichen europäischen Gedankens. Und dieser Gedanke ist untrennbar mit Frieden, Freiheit und Wohlstand verbunden und nicht mit einer Union, die sich als Handlanger einer globalen Kriegsmaschinerie verdingt!
q.t: Those who oppose this Brussels war lust are not enemies of Europe. Quite the contrary: We are the true champions of the original European idea. And this idea is inseparably connected with peace, freedom and prosperity and not with a Union that serves as a henchman of a global war machinery!

ti: Pilnacek-U-Ausschuss: „Schwarzen Staat enttarnen!“
s: FPÖ parliamentary group leader Christian Hafenecker demands document delivery from Interior Minister Karner in the Pilnacek investigative committee, threatens legal action, and calls for testimony from former Justice Minister Alma Zadić regarding alleged ÖVP networks in the justice system.

q.o: Herr Minister Karner, treiben Sie Ihre Spielchen nicht auf die Spitze und reizen Sie die Geduld des Parlaments nicht weiter aus! Wir werden dieses Versteckspiel sicher nicht tatenlos hinnehmen und prüfen bereits rechtliche Schritte, um die Herausgabe dieser Akten zu erzwingen.
q.t: Minister Karner, do not push your games to the limit and do not further exhaust the patience of Parliament! We will certainly not tolerate this hide-and-seek game idly and are already examining legal steps to force the release of these files.

q.o: Ihre eigene Kommission hat eine Zwei-Klassen-Justiz festgestellt. Heute soll die Ex-Justizministerin sagen, wer in dieser Justiz erste Klasse reist
q.t: Your own commission has determined a two-class justice system. Today the former Justice Minister should say who travels first class in this justice system

q.o: Unser Ziel ist klar: Wir legen offen, ob politische Netzwerke im Hintergrund agieren und wie sehr sie unsere Justiz bis heute belasten. Herr Innenminister Karner, liefern Sie die Unterlagen.
q.t: Our goal is clear: We expose whether political networks are operating in the background and how much they burden our justice system to this day. Interior Minister Karner, deliver the documents.

ti: Milliarden-Abzocke an der Zapfsäule – wann fällt endlich die CO2-Steuer?
s: FPÖ demands abolition of CO2 tax and halving of mineral oil tax, claiming this would reduce fuel prices by 40-44 cents per liter and save consumers 20-22 euros per tank fill.

q.o: Diese Regierung hat für ihre Untätigkeit ein englisches Wort gefunden: ‚Monitoring'. Während die Menschen an der Tankstelle immer tiefer ins Geldbörsel greifen müssen, schaut Schwarz-Rot-Pink zu und kassiert mit.
q.t: This government has found an English word for its inaction: 'Monitoring'. While people have to dig deeper into their wallets at the gas station, Black-Red-Pink watches and collects.

q.o: Die Bundesregierung muss endlich ihren Job machen: CO2-Steuer abschaffen und Mineralölsteuer halbieren! Bei vollständiger Weitergabe könnten Benzin um rund 44 Cent und Diesel um rund 40 Cent pro Liter günstiger werden. Das wären 20 bis 22 Euro Ersparnis bei einer Tankfüllung mit 50 Litern
q.t: The federal government must finally do its job: abolish the CO2 tax and halve the mineral oil tax! With complete pass-through, gasoline could become around 44 cents cheaper and diesel around 40 cents per liter. That would be 20 to 22 euros savings on a 50-liter tank fill.

q.o: Den Klimabonus streichen, die CO2-Steuer behalten und dann erklären, für Entlastungen sei kein Geld da: Das ist eine Verhöhnung der Steuerzahler.
q.t: Cut the climate bonus, keep the CO2 tax and then declare there is no money for relief: That is a mockery of taxpayers.

ti: Energie-Schmäh der Verlierer-Ampel: Krisenmechanismus als zahnloser Papiertiger
s: FPÖ energy spokesperson Paul Hammerl criticized the ÖVP-SPÖ-NEOS government's energy crisis mechanism as ineffective due to high trigger thresholds and demanded abolition of national CO2 taxes and EU emissions trading.

q.o: Die Menschen kämpfen mit hohen Energiekosten, und die schwarz-rot-pinke Regierung präsentiert einen Krisenmechanismus, dessen Hürden so gestaltet sind, dass er diesen Winter womöglich gar nicht greift.
q.t: People are struggling with high energy costs, and the black-red-pink government presents a crisis mechanism whose hurdles are designed in such a way that it possibly won't take effect this winter.

q.o: Die nationale CO2-Steuer auf Heiz- und Treibstoffe gehört abgeschafft. Gleichzeitig muss ÖVP-Minister Hattmannsdorfer auf EU-Ebene die Abschaffung der CO2-Bepreisung durch den Emissionshandel einfordern.
q.t: The national CO2 tax on heating and fuels must be abolished. At the same time, ÖVP Minister Hattmannsdorfer must demand the abolition of CO2 pricing through emissions trading at the EU level.

q.o: Zuerst verteuert die schwarz-rot-pinke Regierung die Energie, dann verspricht sie Hilfe, die aber womöglich gar nicht ankommt.
q.t: First the black-red-pink government makes energy more expensive, then it promises help that possibly won't arrive at all.

ti: Autumn Campaigns in Vienna: FPÖ Shakes Ludwig's Chair, While Greens Address Climate Crisis - Vienna.at
s: The FPÖ is conducting an autumn campaign in Vienna challenging Mayor Ludwig's position, while the Greens focus their campaign on climate issues.

ti: Denk (political party) - Wikipedia
s: In 2021, the Islam Democrats party, which had been active on the Hague Municipal Council, merged into DENK.

ti: Prinsjesdag 2026 | Eerdmans: “Kabinet durft geen keuzes te maken”
s: JA21 leader Joost Eerdmans criticized the government's 2026 budget presentation for failing to make clear choices, stating the party will submit initiatives to reduce tax burden and asylum inflow.

q.o: Kabinet durft geen keuzes te maken
q.t: Cabinet doesn't dare to make choices

q.o: De prioriteiten van JA21 zijn helder: werkende Nederlanders moeten meer overhouden, de asielinstroom moet fors omlaag, onze veiligheid moet op orde en de overheid moet minder geld uitgeven.
q.t: JA21's priorities are clear: working Dutch people must keep more, asylum inflow must decrease substantially, our security must be in order and the government must spend less money.

q.o: JA21 blijft constructief in de wedstrijd staan. Onze focus ligt de komende tijd op het indienen van tal van initiatieven om de lastendruk sterk te verminderen en de asielinstroom in te dammen.
q.t: JA21 remains constructively in the game. Our focus in the coming period is on submitting numerous initiatives to strongly reduce the tax burden and stem the asylum inflow.

ti: In Sweden, many breathe sigh of relief as far right suffers election losses - Al Jazeera
s: The Sweden Democrats suffered election losses in Sweden, with many expressing relief at the far-right party's electoral setback.

ti: Vänsterpartiet: Vi ska rusta upp sjukförsäkringen efter valet
s: The Left Party announced on September 10, 2026, that upgrading the sickness insurance system will be a political priority in government negotiations after the election, proposing to abolish the qualifying day deduction, reform the rehabilitation chain, strengthen benefits, and redirect resources within employer contributions.

q.o: Den som blir sjuk ska kunna lita på samhället. I dag är det alldeles för många som i stället tvingas kämpa mot Försäkringskassan samtidigt som de försöker bli friska. Sjukförsäkringen ska försäkra dig, inte utförsäkra dig. Det här är en förändring vi vill få på plats efter valet
q.t: Those who become ill should be able to trust society. Today, far too many are instead forced to fight against the Social Insurance Agency while trying to get well. The sickness insurance should insure you, not exclude you from insurance. This is a change we want to put in place after the election

q.o: Vi har råd med en sjukförsäkring som går att lita på. Under lång tid har politiken valt att flytta pengar bort från våra gemensamma trygghetssystem. Vi vill göra tvärtom. Pengarna ska tillbaka till den trygghet de är tänkta att finansiera
q.t: We can afford a sickness insurance that can be trusted. For a long time, politics has chosen to move money away from our common security systems. We want to do the opposite. The money should go back to the security they are intended to finance

q.o: Vi går till val för att byta regering, men också för att byta politik. Den som röstar för förändring ska märka skillnad i sin vardag. Att den som blir sjuk återigen ska kunna lita på sjukförsäkringen är en sådan förändring. Därför kommer vi att prioritera den här frågan i regeringsförhandlingarna
q.t: We go to the election to change government, but also to change policy. Those who vote for change should notice a difference in their everyday life. That those who become ill should again be able to trust the sickness insurance is such a change. Therefore we will prioritize this issue in the government negotiations

ti: Immigrazione: certificati falsi per evitare rimpatri, si faccia piena luce
s: Brothers of Italy parliamentary leaders called for full investigation into alleged false medical certificates used to prevent detention of irregular migrants in repatriation centers, following police searches of over twenty doctors across Italy ordered by Ravenna prosecutors.

q.o: Le nuove perquisizioni disposte dalla Procura di Ravenna, che coinvolgono oltre venti medici in diverse città italiane, confermano quanto sia necessario fare piena luce su una vicenda che presenta contorni sempre più inquietanti.
q.t: The new searches ordered by the Ravenna Prosecutor's Office, involving over twenty doctors in various Italian cities, confirm how necessary it is to shed full light on an affair that presents increasingly disturbing contours.

q.o: L'ipotesi investigativa di certificazioni mediche utilizzate per impedire il trattenimento nei Cpr di cittadini stranieri irregolari, qualora trovasse conferma, sarebbe di assoluta gravità: non si tratterebbe più di singoli episodi, ma della possibile esistenza di una rete capace, a livello nazionale, di incidere concretamente sull'applicazione delle decisioni dello Stato.
q.t: The investigative hypothesis of medical certifications used to prevent the detention in CPRs of irregular foreign citizens, should it be confirmed, would be of absolute gravity: it would no longer be isolated episodes, but the possible existence of a network capable, at national level, of concretely affecting the application of State decisions.

q.o: Oltre venti medici perquisiti in una decina di città per avere falsificato dei certificati così da impedire a cittadini stranieri irregolari di essere trattenuti nei Centri di permanenza.
q.t: Over twenty doctors searched in about ten cities for having falsified certificates so as to prevent irregular foreign citizens from being detained in detention centers.

ti: Lavoro: clausola salvaguardia Tfr resta, da Pd falsità
s: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni accused the Democratic Party of falsely claiming that the government eliminated worker protections on severance pay (TFR), stating that the safeguard clause remains in Article 21 of Legislative Decree 117/2026 and that the PD misrepresented the abrogation of an old provision in a consolidated text as elimination of the protection.

q.o: Leggo alcuni post di esponenti di primo piano del Partito Democratico e non so sinceramente cosa sia più grave: se, quando li hanno scritti, fossero consapevoli di raccontare una cosa falsa oppure se non lo fossero.
q.t: I read some posts by leading figures of the Democratic Party and I honestly don't know what is more serious: whether, when they wrote them, they were aware of telling something false or whether they were not.

q.o: Ci raccontano che dal 2027 il Governo avrebbe fatto sparire la clausola di salvaguardia sul TFR, con una 'stangata silenziosa' ai danni dei lavoratori.
q.t: They tell us that from 2027 the Government would have made the safeguard clause on TFR disappear, with a 'silent blow' to the detriment of workers.

q.o: Al comma 11 la clausola di salvaguardia sul TFR è lì, nero su bianco.
q.t: In paragraph 11 the safeguard clause on TFR is there, in black and white.

ti: Elezioni: sì del Senato a legge elettorale, preferenze ridanno voce a cittadini
s: The Italian Senate approved an electoral law reform supported by Brothers of Italy that reintroduces preference voting and aims to strengthen governmental stability, with the bill now returning to the Chamber of Deputies for further consideration.

q.o: Grazie a questa legge elettorale si rafforza il rapporto tra chi vota e chi viene eletto. Le preferenze ridanno voce agli elettori e restituiscono agli italiani la possibilità di scegliere i propri rappresentanti.
q.t: Thanks to this electoral law, the relationship between those who vote and those who are elected is strengthened. Preferences give voice back to voters and restore to Italians the possibility of choosing their own representatives.

q.o: Il voto del Senato sulla legge elettorale segna un passo avanti in una battaglia che Fratelli d'Italia porta avanti da tempo: rafforzare il rapporto tra chi vota e chi viene eletto.
q.t: The Senate vote on the electoral law marks a step forward in a battle that Brothers of Italy has been carrying forward for some time: strengthening the relationship between those who vote and those who are elected.

q.o: La riforma non ha ancora concluso il suo percorso: dopo le modifiche approvate al Senato, tornerà alla Camera.
q.t: The reform has not yet concluded its path: after the amendments approved in the Senate, it will return to the Chamber.

ti: Pnrr: commissione Ue certifica successo Italia nell’attuazione
s: Brothers of Italy parliamentarians praised the European Commission's certification of Italy's successful PNRR implementation, crediting party members Raffaele Fitto and Tommaso Foti for rigorous management of the recovery plan.

q.o: Le parole di Claudio Casini, capo della Rappresentanza in Italia della Commissione europea, confermano ciò che Fratelli d'Italia sostiene da tempo: l'attuazione del Pnrr italiano è un successo.
q.t: The words of Claudio Casini, head of the European Commission Representation in Italy, confirm what Brothers of Italy has long maintained: the implementation of the Italian PNRR is a success.

q.o: Un risultato che porta anche la firma di chi ha avuto la responsabilità politica di guidarne l'attuazione: prima Raffaele Fitto e oggi Tommaso Foti.
q.t: A result that also bears the signature of those who had the political responsibility to guide its implementation: first Raffaele Fitto and now Tommaso Foti.

q.o: Si tratta di un riconoscimento che testimonia, come Fratelli d'Italia ha sempre sostenuto, che la nostra Nazione si è distinta nel rispetto degli impegni assunti, facendo sì che il Pnrr diventasse uno strumento concreto di crescita e sviluppo.
q.t: This is a recognition that testifies, as Brothers of Italy has always maintained, that our Nation has distinguished itself in respecting the commitments made, ensuring that the PNRR became a concrete instrument of growth and development.

ti: La Settimana Leghista #37 - Lega per Salvini Premier
s: Lega announces its annual Pontida rally for September 20, 2026 with the slogan "Non passa lo straniero" (The foreigner shall not pass), while proposing policy measures including deploying 10,000 military personnel for street security, pension reform allowing retirement at 64, flat tax increases, and opposition to EU housing regulations.

q.o: NON PASSA LO STRANIERO
q.t: The foreigner shall not pass

q.o: Sarà una Pontida di battaglia. Da sempre c'è chi vorrebbe mettere a tacere la Lega e il suo popolo, chi ci ha dati per finiti e chi ha provato a cancellare le nostre idee. Eppure siamo ancora qui, più determinati che mai a difendere ciò in cui crediamo.
q.t: It will be a Pontida of battle. There have always been those who would like to silence the Lega and its people, those who have written us off and those who have tried to erase our ideas. Yet we are still here, more determined than ever to defend what we believe in.

q.o: La casa per milioni di italiani è il frutto dei sacrifici e dei risparmi di una vita. Non può essere Bruxelles a decidere come, quando e a chi un proprietario può affittarla.
q.t: For millions of Italians, the home is the fruit of a lifetime's sacrifices and savings. Brussels cannot decide how, when and to whom an owner can rent it.

ti: The Wealth Tax: Creating a Fairer, Greener Economy
ac: Green Party of England and Wales
s: The Green Party proposes a wealth tax of 1-2% on assets over £10 million, alongside capital gains tax reform and alignment of investment income tax rates, claiming these measures would generate over £30 billion annually to fund insulation programmes, public water control, and free school meals.

q.o: The Green Party's proposal is highly targeted. It wouldn't affect the homes, pensions, or savings of over 99.9% of the population. Instead, it applies only to those with assets worth more than £10 million. For the 0.04% at this level, a contribution of just 1% (or 2% for billionaires) would be a marginal amount, but it would be life-changing for our country.

The tax on assets and other elements of Green Party tax proposals generate over £30 billion a year: Reforming Capital Gains Tax to align the rates paid by taxpayers on income and taxable gains Aligning tax rates on investment income with the tax and National Insurance Contribution rates on employment income

By raising an estimated £15 billion or more every year, we can invest in the things that matter: Lowering Energy Bills: Funding a nationwide programme to insulate homes, making them warmer and cheaper to run. Lowering Water Bills: Taking water companies into public control, lowering bills and cleaning up our rivers and seas while we're at it Tackling the cost of living: Providing free school meals to all primary and secondary school children to help with inflation of the price of food

ti: Dublin City Council Housing SPC Backs People Before Profit Call to Reverse Council Rent Increases
s: People Before Profit Councillor Conor Reddy's motion calling for reversal of Dublin City Council rent increases passed the Housing and Social Inclusion Strategic Policy Committee by 11 votes to 8, ahead of preparations for the 2027 City Council Budget.

q.o: Today's vote sends a very clear message to the Chief Executive. A majority of members of the Housing SPC do not believe tenants should be made to carry these rent increases, particularly in the middle of a rapidly worsening cost-of-living crisis.

People are understandably angry at being asked to pay more rent for homes that in many cases are still in poor condition. Some tenants are being told that improvements are coming, but may have to wait years to see them. You cannot tell somebody living with damp, mould or a freezing home that they should pay more now and perhaps see the benefit somewhere down the line.

I believe public housing should be accessible to everybody. If we had a broader mix of tenants, including more households on higher incomes paying differential rents, there would be a much stronger and more sustainable revenue base for maintenance.

We will bring today's vote, the arrears figures, the hardship figures and the experiences of tenants directly into that review. I hope the Chief Executive listens to the clear call from the Housing SPC and reverses these increases.

q.o: Όταν ο πρωθυπουργός της χώρας χρειάζεται να βρίσκεται μέσα σε μία γυάλα, την οποία περιφρουρούν 3.500 αστυνομικοί, αυτό σημαίνει ότι έχει χάσει κάθε πραγματική επαφή με τον λαό.

ti: In der Verbots-Dauerschleife der Volkspartei
s: The FPÖ criticizes the ÖVP for rejecting FPÖ proposals to ban political Islam since 2020 while now proposing similar measures, and accuses the ÖVP of enabling mass Muslim immigration and funding deradicalization programs allegedly linked to the Muslim Brotherhood.

q.o: Um die Unglaubwürdigkeit von Stockers plötzlicher Forderung zu entlarven, braucht man sich nur zwei Fragen stellen: Wer trägt die Verantwortung dafür, dass es bis heute kein Verbotsgesetz gegen den politischen Islam gibt? Und wer trägt die Verantwortung dafür, dass wir ein solches Verbotsgesetz überhaupt brauchen, weil der radikale Islamismus die Sicherheit der Menschen in unserem Land bedroht? In beiden Fällen lautet die Antwort: Die ÖVP!
q.t: To expose the incredibility of Stocker's sudden demand, one only needs to ask two questions: Who bears responsibility for the fact that there is still no ban law against political Islam today? And who bears responsibility for the fact that we need such a ban law at all, because radical Islamism threatens the security of people in our country? In both cases the answer is: The ÖVP!

q.o: Damit steht der Verdacht im Raum, dass mit öffentlichem Geld genau jene Entwicklung begünstigt worden sein könnte, die eigentlich verhindert werden sollte. Das muss bis auf den letzten Cent und bis zur letzten Entscheidung aufgeklärt werden
q.t: This raises the suspicion that public money may have been used to promote exactly the development that was supposed to be prevented. This must be clarified down to the last cent and to the last decision

q.o: Wenn die fachliche und pädagogische Qualifikation, die an einer österreichischen Universität erworben wurde, in den Hintergrund rückt und stattdessen die Frage des Kopftuchs zum zentralen Thema eines Bewerbungsgesprächs wird, dann läuft hier etwas grundlegend falsch
q.t: If the professional and pedagogical qualifications acquired at an Austrian university take a back seat and instead the question of the headscarf becomes the central topic of a job interview, then something is fundamentally wrong here

s: Sweden Democrats released their 2026 election campaign film featuring party leader Jimmie Åkesson reflecting on Sweden's changing security situation and his political journey to restore what he describes as a safe and confident Sweden.

q.o: För problemen i vårt land har skapats av dålig politik, som har skapats av dåliga politiker. Och för att få förändring, förändring på riktigt, behöver man också på riktigt byta ut dåliga politiker.
q.t: Because the problems in our country have been created by bad politics, which has been created by bad politicians. And to get change, real change, you also really need to replace bad politicians.

q.o: Jag har blivit hatad, förlöjligad, hånad och utfryst. Nej, det finns inget med min resa som varit särskilt enkelt, men jag tog mig fram, in till maktens centrum för att, för att berätta för dem, hur de förstört vårt land.
q.t: I have been hated, ridiculed, mocked and frozen out. No, there is nothing about my journey that has been particularly easy, but I made my way forward, into the center of power to, to tell them, how they destroyed our country.

q.o: För nu händer det saker. För första gången på väldigt länge börjar saker på riktigt bli bättre.
q.t: Because now things are happening. For the first time in a very long time, things are really starting to get better.

s: NIKI party demands the resignation of Education Minister Sofia Zacharaki and the withdrawal of school textbooks depicting same-sex couples with children, claiming these materials impose an ideological agenda on children.

q.o: Ο Δημήτρης Νατσιός κατήγγειλε από το βήμα της Βουλής, ότι στα νέα βιβλία του Δημοτικού εισάγεται η παρουσίαση ζευγαριών ομοφυλοφίλων με παιδιά ως μορφή οικογένειας.

q.o: Η ΝΙΚΗ απαιτεί την άμεση παραίτηση της Σοφίας Ζαχαράκη και την απόσυρση των επίμαχων βιβλίων πριν χτυπήσει το πρώτο κουδούνι σε μία εβδομάδα.
q.t: NIKI demands the immediate resignation of Sofia Zacharaki and the withdrawal of the controversial books before the first bell rings in one week.

q.o: Τα παιδιά μας δεν είναι πειραματόζωα καμίας ιδεολογικής ατζέντας.
q.t: Our children are not guinea pigs of any ideological agenda.

s: AfD official Martin Reichardt accuses the German government of ignoring left-extremist terror threats announced for the week after the Saxony-Anhalt state election and claims the danger to democracy comes from the left, not the right.

q.t: That Germany has an immense problem with violence-ready left-extremists is well known to sober observers of the political situation in Germany.

q.o: Denn die Gefahr für die Demokratie in Deutschland geht eindeutig und vielbewiesenermaßen von links aus!
q.t: For the danger to democracy in Germany clearly and demonstrably comes from the left!

ti: Tino Chrupalla: Arbeitsplätze in Automobilindustrie dauerhaft sichern - Alternative für Deutschland
s: AfD federal spokesman Tino Chrupalla criticizes the closure of four Volkswagen production sites in Germany, blaming failed economic and energy policy, premature focus on electric mobility, and economic conflicts with Russia and Iran.

q.o: Das Aus für traditionsreiche deutsche Autowerke ist das Resultat einer verfehlten Wirtschafts- und Energiepolitik. Die einseitige und voreilige Fixierung auf Elektromobilität hat die deutsche Schlüsselindustrie in eine Sackgasse geführt. Gleichzeitig zerstören der Wirtschaftskrieg gegen Russland und der Iran-Krieg unsere Versorgung mit bezahlbarer Energie.
q.t: The end for traditional German car factories is the result of failed economic and energy policy. The one-sided and premature fixation on electric mobility has led the German key industry into a dead end. At the same time, the economic war against Russia and the Iran war are destroying our supply of affordable energy.

q.o: Deutschland braucht endlich wieder eine technologieoffene, ausgewogene Industriepolitik, die das Rückgrat unserer Wirtschaft schützt.
q.t: Germany finally needs a technology-open, balanced industrial policy again that protects the backbone of our economy.

ti: Tino Chrupalla und Alice Weidel: Wahl in Sachsen-Anhalt entscheidend für die Zukunft Deutschlands - Alternative für Deutschland
s: AfD federal co-leaders Chrupalla and Weidel call the Saxony-Anhalt state election decisive for Germany's future, with lead candidate Ulrich Siegmund polling over 40 percent, emphasizing enforcement of laws on illegal migration and urging supporters to serve as election observers.

q.o: Die AfD Sachsen-Anhalt hat ein klares Ziel für den Wahlsieg formuliert: Sie möchte geltendes Recht – beispielsweise mit Blick auf illegale Migration – durchsetzen und dafür sorgen, dass Deutschland lebenswert bleibt.
q.t: The AfD Saxony-Anhalt has formulated a clear goal for electoral victory: It wants to enforce existing law – for example with regard to illegal migration – and ensure that Germany remains livable.

q.o: Entsprechend ist eine absolute Mehrheit für Ulrich Siegmund und die AfD fast die einzige Chance, das Ruder doch noch herumzureißen.
q.t: Accordingly, an absolute majority for Ulrich Siegmund and the AfD is almost the only chance to turn things around.

ti: Motion adoptée par les salarié•es contre l’arrivée de Charles Sapin à Radio France : stop à l’entrisme de l’extrême droite au sein du service public de l’audiovisuel !
s: La France insoumise supports Radio France employees who unanimously adopted a motion opposing the appointment of Charles Sapin from Valeurs actuelles and threatens strike action, criticizing what they call far-right infiltration of public broadcasting and promising media reform if elected in 2027.

q.o: Nous ne pouvons que saluer le courage des salarié•es de Radio France, qui défendent ce qui reste de l'honneur du service public de l'audiovisuel.
q.t: We can only salute the courage of Radio France employees, who defend what remains of the honor of public broadcasting service.

q.o: Alors que l'extrême droite progresse partout dans le pays, et que la propagation de son idéologie est accélérée par des médias privés détenus par des patrons réactionnaires, l'audiovisuel public a une responsabilité particulière en matière de lutte contre la diffusion de fausses informations et d'apaisement du débat public.
q.t: While the far right is advancing everywhere in the country, and the spread of its ideology is accelerated by private media owned by reactionary bosses, public broadcasting has a particular responsibility in fighting the spread of false information and calming public debate.

q.o: En 2027, nous changerons tout. Notre première priorité sera de refonder intégralement le fonctionnement des médias publics et privés.
q.t: In 2027, we will change everything. Our first priority will be to completely rebuild the functioning of public and private media.

ti: Plan Genevard : 1 milliard pour ne surtout rien changer

q.o: Le monde agricole a traversé cet été une crise inédite, subissant en première ligne les conséquences du changement climatique et de l'inaction du Gouvernement.
q.t: The agricultural sector experienced an unprecedented crisis this summer, suffering on the front lines from the consequences of climate change and government inaction.

q.o: La moitié de l'enveloppe ira à des agriculteurs qui sont déjà assurés, c'est-à-dire une minorité. Ceux dont les pertes ne sont pas assurées auprès d'assureurs privés auront beaucoup moins.
q.t: Half of the funding will go to farmers who are already insured, meaning a minority. Those whose losses are not insured with private insurers will receive much less.

q.o: Il est inacceptable que le plan annoncé se fasse au prix d'encore plus d'austérité pour les autres ministères et le reste du pays, à l'heure où les versements de dividendes battent des records.
q.t: It is unacceptable that the announced plan comes at the cost of even more austerity for other ministries and the rest of the country, at a time when dividend payments are breaking records.
